label: MONEY TIP
hook: The 24-hour rule that helps stop impulse buys

slides.text: Want something that costs over ₹2,000? Don't buy it right away.
Add it to a list and wait 24 hours.
slides.sub: Many urges fade by the next day

slides.text: Still want it tomorrow? Check that it fits this month's budget first.
Skip just one ₹2,000 impulse buy a month, and that's ₹24,000 a year.
Try this today: start a 'wait 24 hours' list on your phone.
